name: Thai Fish Sauce
siboNotes: Fish sauce is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. Use as desired for flavor without FODMAP concerns.
preparationTips: A little goes a long way - start with small amounts as it's very salty
Store in pantry after opening - refrigeration not required
Mix with lime juice and chili for a quick dipping sauce
Add at end of cooking to preserve flavor
pairsWellWith: Bok choy and other Asian greens
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in umami compounds for deep savory flavor
Source of B vitamins from fermentation process
Low in calories but high in sodium
